scope: Manual review of all 20 native Plan screenshots, all tab transitions, and source/answer records; this is not exhaustive fact checking or a production acceptance gate.

baseline_findings.02: Called a 30% rain forecast dry; limited place query omitted parks.
baseline_findings.07: Recommended outdoor running from weather despite unhealthy forecast AQI. Fixed with an explicit indoor-plan rule.
baseline_findings.08: Reversed Saturday/Sunday rain and described equal forecast AQI values as different. Host comparisons corrected the rerun.
baseline_findings.10: Prioritized the wetter day without a clear tradeoff.
baseline_findings.11: Called the hotter city more comfortable and overstated outdoor suitability; rerun includes heat and unhealthy-air constraints.
baseline_findings.13: A title called 31% rain lower than 30%; daylight title/body reasoning conflicted. Rerun uses host-computed daylight duration and rain comparisons.
baseline_findings.14: Described a 32 C daily high as mild/comfortable. Rerun calls for heat planning.
baseline_findings.19: Inferred greater volatility from a single-session move and suggested market concerns without supporting evidence. Still needs stronger semantic constraints.

template_needs_content_review.09: Packing prose labels the rounded low-to-high temperature range as highs. It should distinguish overnight lows from daily highs.
template_needs_content_review.10: Calls 2026-09-13 Saturday and 2026-09-12 Friday. The numeric preferred date is Sunday; weekday names in the title and summary are wrong.
template_needs_content_review.17: Third pick calls a single-session move momentum/weakness despite the explicit limitation. No news was retrieved in this run.
template_needs_content_review.19: Infers research priority from one-session resilience and states both companies benefit from a market forecast without direct company evidence.

remaining_product_limits: This experiment binds a completed snapshot; it does not add arbitrary intent search or incremental publication to the normal Octos composer.
The L0 source contract and widget vocabulary are intentionally bounded; the study does not test unrestricted app generation with the normal large reference prefix.
The small OpenStreetMap query is biased toward some map object types and sometimes returns only museums. Lack of a park result does not mean no park exists.
News source reliability is insufficient for a production watchlist. This experiment uses indexed excerpts, not the separate full-article news pipeline.
Some titles, source labels and metrics remain English in Chinese compositions. Cards are vertically dense and later recommendations require scrolling.
A valid layout, valid source ID and deterministic tool schedule do not prove the prose follows the evidence.
